numericGrammarImpactConditions: All fe/de/e and ParseExpression ASTs share native runtime kinds; @noopt disables Optimize but does not select old decimal arithmetic.
Finite real literals use Double rounding; decimal precision and decimal overflow expectations change. Nonfinite 1e9999 remains rejected.
Native B/KB/MB/GB/TB size literals truncate Double product to Int64; legacy IEC unit extensions remain separately identified.
Arithmetic precedence and unary minus, Duration and Version typed literals now parse; old unsupported-syntax failures may become accepted values or runtime None.
Root and logical/comparison operands are not statically restricted to Bool/String/matching kinds; runtime Bool/None/Array short circuit and typed Compare decide the result.

Typed Compare preserves source combinations and asymmetry: Int/Double compare numerically, incompatible kinds fall through to EQ false/NE true, Double-left String retains its special None contract. Non-String text operators return None; root ContainsTrue can be false after successful compilation.
Default Optimize and explicit @opt visit children left to right even below runtime short circuit or absent providers; @noopt preserves runtime short circuit.
Int/Double/String/Bool/DateTime/Array/Regex/None runtime kind does not replace Size/Duration/Version literal AST provenance when folding.
Unprefixed field arrays for dirs 2/3 and missing sides are global independently of Prop collection; explicit prefixes/aliases remain scalar where defined.
Rule e/fe/de dispatch still depends on each side kind; f/d/f!/d! regular-expression matching and standalone one-pane Matches remain unchanged.
Unknown function, arity, explicit function type guards, cancellation, work limits, property name collection and input/output protection remain required checks.
